verdict.rationale: BVNK's payment docs describe a 'crypto converted and received in fiat' mode: merchants accept stablecoin payments and receive fiat in their account, with BVNK handling the conversion and settlement and quoting each payment live. Separate fiat payout docs cover first- and third-party bank payouts from virtual accounts. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented automatic sweep from converted fiat balance to an external bank payout (payouts are documented separately), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs and marketing.
